veranderings.rede: Copies of a book 'versprei' through a region; 'beweeg' reads wooden here.

veranderings.na: Baie lesers het op dié manier
veranderings.rede: Avoids starting two consecutive sentences with the same 'so' construction.
'dinge' is the standard word for things here; 'goed' after 'plekke en' can be misread as the adjective 'good'.
The subject is 'lesers' of a book, so 'gelees' matches; reviewer should drop this if 'gehoor' deliberately includes hearing it read aloud.

veranderings.blok: Party het geglo en party nie
veranderings.voor: Ander lesers het Marco Polo geglo en het sy verslag
veranderings.na: Ander lesers het Marco Polo wel geglo en sy verslag
veranderings.rede: 'wel' marks the contrast with the previous sentence, and the repeated 'het' is unnecessary in the joined clause.

veranderings.na: het ná Marco Polo se tyd aangehou
veranderings.rede: Marco Polo is not named in this block, so 'sy' has no clear referent.
